steps.title: Analyze Build Error Logs
steps.description: Review the provided build error logs to identify the root causes of the build failure, specifically focusing on XML parsing issues and dependency problems.

steps.title: Fix Malformed Layout XML
steps.description: Address the 'Content is not allowed in trailing section' error in activity_main.xml by ensuring the XML structure is perfectly formed and free of any extraneous characters after the root element.

steps.title: Update Android Manifest for Modern Gradle
steps.description: Remove the deprecated 'package' attribute from the AndroidManifest.xml's <manifest> tag, as its value is now handled by the 'namespace' in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Remove Unauthorized External Dependency
steps.description: Eliminate the 'org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd' dependency from app/build.gradle, ensuring the project adheres to the rule of using only Android SDK built-in classes.

steps.title: Verify Java Compatibility
steps.description: Confirm that all Java code in MainActivity.java and build configurations remain compatible with Java 8, as required by the build environment.

steps.title: Update Application Metadata
steps.description: Synchronize the version_code and version_name in app-meta.json to reflect the latest values specified in app/build.gradle, ensuring consistency across project metadata.

steps.title: Review Build Environment Settings
steps.description: Check build.gradle and settings.gradle for any other potential misconfigurations or outdated settings that might hinder a successful build.

steps.title: Perform Final Code Review
steps.description: Conduct a comprehensive review of all modified files to ensure adherence to all specified Android build rules, proper syntax, and logical correctness.

steps.title: Verify Project Integrations
steps.description: Ensure that changes to XML and Gradle files do not inadvertently break existing Java code or UI functionality of the calculator app.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: The final step to compile and assemble the Android application package (APK) after applying all necessary fixes.
